CustomField.description: Entry-point (master) call id of the Dialpad transfer call bound to this lead. Stamped by the dialpad-sf-webhook: at the entry-point leg for pool-owned transfer leads, and again whenever an answered leg assigns/reassigns the lead. Lets the webhook find the exact lead for a call instead of matching by phone, and tells a retransfer (new call id) apart from a second leg of the same call.
CustomField.label: Dialpad Call ID
